Jordan (New Hire): Hi team, quick weirdness  I have two "Company Orientation" events on my calendar for next Tue: one at 09:00 CET and one at 10:00 CET. Both say organizer people-ops@redwood.com. Which is the real one? The invites have different event IDs and neither has a recording note.

Maya (People Ops): Hey Jordan, welcome! :wave: We run two overlapping recurrences during DST transitions sometimes. Can you paste both event IDs? Also are you on Outlook or Google calendar?

Jordan (New Hire): Event IDs are 990112 and 990113. I'm on Google but I synced my work account into Outlook desktop so not sure which calendar surface is showing duplicates.

Nina (Onboarding Lead): Hi Jordan  990112 is the normal EU weekly, 990113 is a one-off we created to cover a timezone-change test (should have been unpublished). Sorry about the noise. We'll cancel 990113 so you only see 09:00 CET.

Jordan (New Hire): Cool, thanks. Also, for teammates in the UK it shows as 08:00 BST. Will the invite auto-shift for DST next month? I'm worried I might end up joining the wrong time permanently.

Leo - IT: It will shift with the event timezone as long as the event's base timezone is set to Europe/Paris (CET/CEST). If you ever see the organizer timezone as GMT or PST that's the clue it's a misconfigured recurrence. If you use Outlook desktop, sometimes it caches the old timezone; restarting Outlook usually refreshes.

calendar-bot: Event 990113 cancelled by Nina (Onboarding Lead).

Jordan (New Hire): Thanks! One more question: if I miss the session, where's the recording posted? I use Drive primarily, but our company uses Confluence too.

Maya (People Ops): Recordings go to our onboarding S3 and we link them on the New Hires Confluence page under "Orientation Recordings". We also paste the Confluence link into the canceled event so late joiners can find it easily. We'll ping this channel when the recording is up.

Jordan (New Hire): Perfect. FYI the calendar invites didn't show a clickable Zoom link on mobile (iOS Calendar app)  only a passcode box. Not sure if that's a Redwood calendar/conference provider quirk.

Leo - IT: iOS sometimes hides the deep link if the organizer used a meeting provider token instead of an explicit URL. If you open the event in Google Calendar web and hit "Show original", you should see the `https://redwood.zoom.us/j/` line. If not, DM me and I'll attach the join link to 990112.

Nina (Onboarding Lead): I've added a short note to the 09:00 CET invite: "Zoom link in event description; recording posted to Confluence within 24hrs". Also adjusted the event timezone to Europe/Paris.

Jordan (New Hire): Link visible now on web and mobile. Thanks everyone for the quick fixes  excited to start!

Maya (People Ops): Welcome aboard, Jordan! We'll also add a small banner on the Confluence page about DST and calendar caching for future hires. :sparkles:
